mapper.select: SELECT c.review_comment_id AS reviewCommentId, c.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, c.review_post_id AS reviewPostId, c.review_comment_content AS reviewCommentContent, TO_CHAR(c.review_comment_regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reviewCommentRegdate, c.review_comment_report_count AS reviewCommentReportCount, c.review_comment_status AS reviewCommentStatus FROM tblReviewComment c JOIN tblUser u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.review_post_id = #{reviewPostId} AND c.review_comment_status = 'A' ORDER BY c.review_comment_regdate ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tblReviewComment ( review_comment_id, user_id, review_post_id, review_comment_content, review_comment_regdate, review_comment_report_count, review_comment_status ) VALUES ( seqReviewComment.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{reviewPostId}, #{reviewCommentContent}, SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 0, 'A' )
mapper.update: UPDATE tblReviewComment SET review_comment_status = 'D' WHERE review_comment_id = #{reviewCommentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblReviewComment WHERE review_post_id = #{reviewPostId} AND review_comment_status = 'A'
